scripts.typecheck: pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @actionpop/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @actionpop/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @actionpop/worker typecheck
scripts.check:static: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:dead && pnpm check:cycles && pnpm check:spell && pnpm check:toolchain && pnpm check:licenses
scripts.dev:postgres: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d postgres
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis postgres
scripts.dev:tools: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis postgres redisinsight bull-board
scripts.dev:redis: docker compose -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d redis
scripts.db:setup: pnpm dev:infra || echo 'WARN: dependencies not started; start Redis and Postgres manually.'; pnpm prisma:generate && pnpm prisma:migrate
scripts.geo:refresh: pnpm --filter @actionpop/core build && pnpm --filter @actionpop/worker build && node scripts/geographic-refresh.mjs
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm dev:infra || echo 'WARN: could not start Docker dependencies; start Redis and Postgres manually.'; pnpm db:setup && pnpm --filter @actionpop/core build && pnpm --filter @actionpop/worker dev
scripts.start:worker: pnpm --filter @actionpop/core build && pnpm --filter @actionpop/worker build && node apps/worker/dist/main.js
